answer: The wander counter is kept in atlas and thread publishes each reset. An adversary hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1088 identities would post 2364 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
